accountsConnectHow: How do you want to connect {provider}?

accountsCustomApiAccessRefused: The server refused access. Check what this key is allowed to use.
accountsCustomApiApproveCertificates: I approve these certificates only for this private connection
accountsCustomApiCancelled: The check stopped before it finished. Press Save to try again.
accountsCustomApiCapabilityHint: Save checks the chosen profile and cache setting. Checks may incur charges; they do not prove reasoning or a cache hit. Your server may cache automatically, even with None.
accountsCustomApiCertificateAdd: {host}'s certificate could not be verified. Add your organization's certificate below.
accountsCustomApiCertificatePolicy: Choose a valid public CA certificate and approve it for this connection.
accountsCustomApiCertificateTooLarge: Choose a public CA file no larger than 64 KiB.
accountsCustomApiCertificateUnreadable: This certificate file could not be read.
accountsCustomApiCertificatesHint: A public CA certificate from your organization, trusted only for this connection. Private keys and client certificates are not supported. Server name, chain and expiry checks stay on.
accountsCustomApiCheckBeforeUse: Edit and Save to check these models before use.
accountsCustomApiCheckModelFirst: Edit and Save to check this model first.
accountsCustomApiChooseCertificate: Choose a local PEM CA file
accountsCustomApiChooseQuestion: Which model should your first mate answer with?
accountsCustomApiCommandApproval: Save or Fetch from server runs this command to get a token. Infinitary runs it again after the refresh interval or one refusal.
accountsCustomApiCommandHint: Runs on {who} with your access. Prints only the token. Renew your organization’s sign-in outside Infinitary when needed.
accountsCustomApiCommandNeeded: Enter a token command and a positive whole number of seconds.
accountsCustomApiCrewUse: Crew use for these models is set on the Models board, further down Intelligence.
accountsCustomApiCrewUseRemote: Crew use for these models is set on the Models board, further down Intelligence. A model here runs only on {who}.
accountsCustomApiCrewUseSettings: Crew use for these models is set on the Models board in Settings, under Intelligence.
accountsCustomApiDestinationMixed: Infinitary can't send to this address. DNS answered {answered}. They point to more than one kind of network.
accountsCustomApiDestinationMixedNever: Infinitary can't send to this address. DNS answered {answered}. They point to more than one kind of network. Infinitary makes no exception for an answer that points to {here}, a link-local or a cloud metadata address.
accountsCustomApiDestinationRefused: Infinitary can't send to this address: it points to a reserved address, or to more than one kind of network.
accountsCustomApiDestinationReserved: Infinitary can't send to this address. DNS answered {answered}. A reserved answer often comes from a proxy app or a DNS filter that answers for every name.
accountsCustomApiDestinationReservedNeve: Infinitary can't send to this address. DNS answered {answered}. A reserved answer often comes from a proxy app or a DNS filter that answers for every name. Infinitary makes no exception for an answer that points to {here}, a link-local or a cloud metadata address.
accountsCustomApiDisconnectRemote: Disconnect removes this connection on {who}. {here} keeps no copy of its key.
accountsCustomApiDisconnectWarning: Disconnect immediately stops matching work and your first mate if it uses this connection. It removes only this connection locally, keeps your task history, and does not move stopped work to another server. It cannot revoke the server’s key or erase content already sent.
accountsCustomApiException: Make an exception for {host}: send to it whatever DNS answers, apart from {who} itself, link-local and cloud metadata addresses. Do this only if you know why DNS answers this way, such as a proxy app.
accountsCustomApiFootHint: Save sends {sent} to this address, then checks each model. It may use a few tokens.
accountsCustomApiFullAddress: Enter the full address, starting with https:// or http://, with no query or sign-in in it.
accountsCustomApiHeaders: Check the extra headers: each name once with a one-line value, and no name Infinitary sets itself. A secret value is entered again for a new address.
accountsCustomApiHeadersHint: Headers your organization’s server needs on every request. A secret value is masked, never shown again, and refused if a reply repeats it.
accountsCustomApiHttp: Send over unencrypted HTTP. Anyone on the network path can read the key, prompts, project code and replies, or change replies that direct work on {who}.
accountsCustomApiHttpApproved: Unencrypted HTTP is approved for this address.
accountsCustomApiHttpFirst: Approve unencrypted HTTP first: fetching sends your key to this address.
accountsCustomApiHttpPrivate: Send over unencrypted HTTP. Anyone on the network path can read the key, prompts, project code and replies, or change replies that direct work on {who}. On shared Wi-Fi, another private server may answer for your organization's name.
accountsCustomApiHttpPublic: Send over unencrypted HTTP. Anyone on the network path can read the key, prompts, project code and replies, or change replies that direct work on {who}. This includes the public internet; use only a server and network path you trust.
accountsCustomApiHttpToSave: Approve unencrypted HTTP to save this address.
accountsCustomApiIncompatible: {model} didn't finish the test's tool call. Infinitary needs tool calls for work; try another model or the other API protocol.
accountsCustomApiKeyEmpty: Leave empty if the server needs none
accountsCustomApiKeyFormat: Enter the key as one line of plain text, with no spaces at either end.
accountsCustomApiKeyGoesTo: It goes to {who} once. {here} keeps no copy.
accountsCustomApiLimits: This server doesn't list this model's sizes. Enter its context and output tokens.
accountsCustomApiListFailed: Could not read your custom connections.

accountsCustomApiListed.one: This server lists {count} model. Pick the ones you would like to use:
accountsCustomApiListed.other: This server lists {count} models. Pick the ones you would like to use:

accountsCustomApiListedNone: This server lists no models. Add them by hand.
accountsCustomApiMalformed: {model} sent a reply Infinitary could not read.

accountsCustomApiModelTwice: This model is already in the list.
accountsCustomApiModelsNeeded: Add at least one model, or fetch the server's list.
accountsCustomApiNoList: This server doesn’t list its models. Add them by hand.
accountsCustomApiNoModels: No models yet. Fetch them from the server, or add one by hand.
accountsCustomApiNotReached: This server could not be reached.

accountsCustomApiNotSavedRow: Not saved. Fix the marked row and press Save again.
accountsCustomApiNothingAnsweredV1: Nothing answered at {where}/{operation}. Many servers end in /v1.
accountsCustomApiOperationAddress: This is the address of one operation. Use the server's base address.
accountsCustomApiOutputTooLarge: Enter an output size smaller than the context size.
accountsCustomApiOversized: {model}'s reply was larger than the test allows.
accountsCustomApiPausedHint: Paused. Resume to use these models.
accountsCustomApiPrepareFailed: Your first mate could not prepare this connection. Try again.
accountsCustomApiProfilesFailed: Capability profiles could not be read. Close and reopen this form to try again.
accountsCustomApiRateLimit: The server is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment, then press Save again.

accountsCustomApiResumeNeedsCheck: Edit and Save to check these models before resuming.
accountsCustomApiResumeToUse: Resume this connection to use it.

accountsCustomApiTestSlow: {model} took too long to answer the test.
accountsCustomApiTrustHint: Connect only a server you trust. It receives your key and what Infinitary sends, may charge for requests, and its model can direct work on {who}. Keys are kept in private files on {who}, not encrypted storage.
accountsCustomApiUnreachable: Could not reach {host}. Check that it is running and that you are on its network.
